name: Protagonist for the Song of Radiance
source: Having lost her father in battle, she along with her mother and [url=/c75035]little brother[/url] work in the restaurant that he left behind to them. One day an evil magistrate sends for her little brother, Yahiko, to become a poison taster. To save Yahiko's life, she disguises herself as a boy and goes in his stead to serve inside the castle of a famous samurai.
